note.zh: 本站说明：仅 OpenAI 原生模型可用，走 Claude / Gemini 会报错；同一模型有多个渠道时要带同一个 prompt_cache_key，否则可能找不到上一次的响应，推荐手动拼接历史。
note.en: On this site: only OpenAI-native models support it; Claude and Gemini return an error. When a model has several channels, send the same prompt_cache_key or the previous response may not be found. Prefer resending the history yourself.

note.en: On this site: send the same value within a conversation so requests stay on the same channel and hit the cache more often.
